claim: Our guidance for growth for financial year '26 is 0% to 3% in constant currency terms.
actual: FY26 revenue grew 3.1% in constant currency (guidance was raised to 1-3% in July 2025 and upgraded again in January 2026).

evidence.quote: FY26 revenues crossed $20 bn and grew 3.1% in constant currency terms, within the upgraded guidance band given in January

claim: Our margin guidance for financial year 2026 is 20% to 22%.
actual: FY26 adjusted operating margin 21.0% (reported IFRS 20.3% after Labour Code charges).

evidence.quote: Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%

claim: We expect FY'26 free cash flows to be above 100% of net profit.
actual: FY26 free cash flow $3.7 bn vs net profit $3,313 mn ≈ 112% (adjusted for Labour Code and tax refunds: $3.5 bn, still above 100%).

evidence.quote: healthy Free Cash Flow of $3.7 Billion
Free cash flow adjusted for the Labor Code and income tax refunds stood at $3.5 bn for FY

claim: We expect effective tax rate for financial year '26 to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
actual: FY26 effective tax rate ≈ 26.4% (income tax $1,190 mn on PBT $4,506 mn), below the range because of reversal of prior-year provisions after favourable tax orders — outside the guided range, but favourably.

evidence.quote: Profit before income taxes | 4,506 | 4,447 | 1.3% Income tax expense (1) | 1,190 | 1,285 | -7.4%
Tax rate for the quarter is lower due to reversal of prior year tax provisions, as a result of favorable tax orders

claim: We hired 15,000 freshers this year and expect to hire over 20,000 freshers in FY'26.
actual: Onboarded more than 20,000 freshers in FY26.

evidence.quote: We onboarded more than 20,000 freshers in FY26

claim: At this point-in-time, the endeavour is to improve margins from where we are for FY'26.
actual: Adjusted operating margin was flat at 21% (FY25: 21.1%); reported margin fell to 20.3%. Gains were reinvested rather than expanding margin.

evidence.quote: Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%. Gains from currency and Maximus were reinvested in talent, AI and sales and marketing

claim: We expect Project Maximus to further aid in margin improvements from current levels.
actual: Maximus delivered realisation gains (growth was led by realisation; +30 bps tailwind in Q4) but the gains were reinvested and margin did not improve.

evidence.quote: Volumes for the year were flattish, growth was led by increase in realization thanks to Project Maximus

claim: Looking at what we have signed and what we have in the pipeline, we expect FY'26 third-party costs to be lower than FY'25.
actual: Third-party costs were down by 1% of revenue in FY26.

evidence.quote: lower third-party costs which was down by 1% as percentage of revenue

claim: If we close [the two announced acquisitions] in the Q1, the benefit that we would get would be 40-to-50 basis points for the full year, which is not baked in the guidance.
actual: Acquisitions contributed about 70 bps to FY26 growth.

evidence.quote: Acquisitions contributed about 70 bps on full year growth

claim: Most of our employees got the wage hikes in January and the middle level to senior level employees will get wage hike, effective 1st of April.
actual: Q1 FY26 margin absorbed the balance compensation hike (100 bps headwind from compensation increase).

evidence.quote: Sequential margin resilience was despite absorbing balance compensation hike

claim: Including the interim dividend, the total payout for FY'25 will be Rs. 43, an increase of 13.2% once the final dividend is approved by the shareholders.
actual: FY25 dividend per share was Rs 43.00 (FY26: Rs 48.00, +11.6%).
